notes.title: 4/4/2017 Update
notes.notes:
Frantic Freighter has been updated! Changelog:

Updated to 5.4.5p1 Unity engine
Updated SteamVR to latest 1.2.1
Increased player movement speed
Held parts now more closely & quickly track your hand
Added a "crosshair" to more easily select & pickup items
Shrunk map stand to make it easier to move about the cabin
Map will flip to allow being viewed & operated from the back
Moved map forward to make it easier to be used from the back

notes.title: Prompt & Engine Update
notes.notes:
By popular demand, I've added an "Escape to Quit" prompt when not playing in virtual reality. I've also updated Frantic Freighter to Unity 5.4.3f1, which is the latest stable build at this time.

I've also redone a bunch of the movement & mouse code, which should at the very least be more efficient.
